Caney City has a 2026 population of 214. Caney City is currently growing at a rate of 2.39% annually and its population has increased by 15.05% since the most recent census, which recorded a population of 186 in 2020. The median household income in Caney City is $73,125 with a poverty rate of 18.75%. The median age in Caney City is 59.3 years: 61.1 years for males, and 58.8 years for females.
